hash_2f25792d99982193: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Mason: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Command sounded confident. Once we blow the shit out of their radio tower and create a distraction... we'll find out.
hash_430e338d4ef09329: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Alright, take us down! It's time for a little hide and seek!
hash_27b76876666c1d97: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Rudnik better be in that base if we came all this fucking way.
hash_3e143c8c2aa7fb94: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Command: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Go ahead and mark the radio tower for us.
hash_41fa8f0b5c59cc01: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Command: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Now get down there and eliminate Rudnik before he escapes.
hash_18f07225fcd34031: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Command: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Roger that. There's an airmail package ready for delivery. Just need an address.
hash_352960dc4e7266d5: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Command: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Roger. The check is in the mail.
hash_243fae48c4bdfd23: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Come on, Mason. Mark the fucking tower.
hash_4e993a95ff675f07: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Get your ass down the wall, Mason!
hash_1efc88ef4d406fe: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Mason, mark that radio tower on the ridge.
hash_637d858cf5a0ce49: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Mason, take your line down! I'll have your back from up here.
hash_5f1caa501fbc5364: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Mason, the tower's up above on that far ridge.
hash_1fa0091177c13e32: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We don't have a lot of time to mess this guy up.
hash_34874d77ed40eebc: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Mason: ^7^Fmaxima_med^In the target area. Looking for Rudnik.
hash_486ac516ce845ad4: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Mason: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Kill confirmed. We've got the pic to prove it.
hash_23cdbd85af7f3c11: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Command needs a clear view, or they can't tell it's Rudnik.
hash_5cd279e602108d63: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Fuck, look out. RPG on the roof.
hash_6532e0dc1a1131cc: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Get the whole body. You take pictures like my grandma.
hash_2ddeab80a79cef27: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Maybe next time we can draw pictures for them too.
hash_f6ee34bc93300d3: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Mason, you got snipers staring you down.
hash_c68259d15f74d09: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Move to the other building. I've got overwatch.
hash_1d2604ceb5bab14c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Roger. Move to the other buildings. I've got you covered.
hash_95d22fc80a02e87: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Rudnik just got out! Go after him!
hash_5ee40e011e108322: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Go on and move to the next building.
hash_792489ab68c819c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Use your camera, Mason. We need a photo of this asshole.
hash_6c7646d1f60e40a2: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You can't stay still. You've got to move!
hash_7db4637c56368747: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We need a photo of Rudnik for Langley, Mason.
hash_76742ccd08b8ba78: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We're not on vacation, Mason. Take a photo of Rudnik.
hash_6e417c94734379b2: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You need a clear picture of the body.
hash_593b079d4f169c13: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Command: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Call it in if you need it.
hash_ae0fc9d4e0ba114: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Command: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Mason, we can't bring the chopper down until you mark a location.
hash_268c64e29cafa317: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Command: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Mason, we have air support on stand-by.
hash_6cfdfe1851b3f550: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Command: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Nice work. Evac chopper inbound. Pop some smoke to mark your location.
hash_3a4f620a59b49e02: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Command: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What's your situation down there? We need some smoke.
hash_72528dc0a1567291: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Also... it's cold as fuck out here.
hash_7691eff26c9bf070: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Don't fucking forget me. It's a long walk home.
hash_1cc4fbbf7aca5024: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Get on the damn chopper, Mason. I'm not on overwatch.
hash_7da288e2fd14438: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I think Perseus is gonna cry like a fucking baby when he hears we iced Rudnik. And I hate babies. We're done here, Mason!
hash_73a298e2f491a72: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I think Perseus is gonna get the memo. Let's head out, Mason!
hash_5eb7661707c00a5a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I think they really like us, Mason!
hash_1673e4004191a696: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Might want to call in that air support!
hash_78e2542f40932cc3: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Move your ass so we can get out of here.
